title: 日銀、高市政権への配慮見え隠れ　為替介入は「苦肉の策」の面も
extracted_text: 政府・日銀が、円安食い止めのため2024年7月以来となる円買い・ドル売り介入に踏み切った。だが、中東情勢の混乱を受けた原油高や日米金利差などを背景とした円売り圧力は「構造的」な問題となっている。電撃介入はひとまず成果をあげたものの、市場では「効果は一時的で、再び円安の流れに戻る」との見方が多い。 4月30日に急速に円安・ドル高が進んだ原因の一つである日銀の追加利上げ見送り。記者会見で植田和男総裁は中東情勢の緊迫化により様子見する姿勢を強調したが、利上げに否定的な高市早苗政権への配慮も見え隠れする。
translated_text: The government and the Bank of Japan intervened in the foreign exchange market (buying yen and selling dollars) to stop yen depreciation since July 2024. However, the yen-selling pressure driven by the Middle East situation turmoil and the Japan-US interest rate gap has become a "structural" issue. While the lightning intervention achieved results for now, the prevailing market view is that "the effect is temporary and yen will depreciate again." One of the reasons for the rapid yen depreciation on April 30 was the Bank of Japan's decision to postpone additional rate hikes. At the press conference, Governor Ueda emphasized a wait-and-see stance due to the escalating Middle East situation, but signs of consideration toward the Takaichi administration, which opposes rate hikes, were also apparent.
title_en: Bank of Japan Shows Consideration to Takaichi Administration Amid Foreign Exchange Intervention Described as 'Last Resort'
